remarks: Welcome to 76 Palmer Street, your newly renovated 4-bedroom, 1.5 bath home in the heart of Stamford. With 1,416 sq ft above grade plus 768 sq ft of finished lower-level space, this home offers plenty of room to spread out, entertain, or work from home.The main level is bright and open, featuring hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and a classic brick fireplace that adds warmth and character. The updated kitchen includes white shaker cabinets, quartz counters, a full backsplash, porcelain tile floors, stainless-steel appliances, and a gas range, great for anyone who loves to cook. The convenience of a first-floor bedroom adds flexibility for guests, multi-generational living, or a dedicated home office. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms and a beautifully updated full bath with a double vanity and glass-enclosed shower. The finished lower level provides even more flexible living space, perfect for a family room, gym, office, or play area.Outside, the backyard is flat, open, and very usable, and part of it doubles as the driveway. You park at the back of the property, then walk to a set of steps leading directly to the rear entrance, super convenient for daily living. There is also plenty of street parking in the front, making it easy for guests or multiple vehicles. Modern features include central heat and air and a tankless water heater for comfort and efficiency.
